title: XTRIME – Fruit Vibes
description:
Extreme Fruit Vibes🍇🍉🍃 is an incredible line of nicotine pouches that captivates with its fantastic palette of flavors.

Offers incredibly fresh flavors that take your nicotine pouch experience to another level of EXTREME😎. Contains 16mg nicotine/1

It includes the most intense aromas, namely: tropical lime, delicate spearmint, mint, and various forest fruits.

This combination will hit you right in the heart!

Extreme🔥 is medium-strength and tobacco-free🌿. It provides a smooth long-lasting effect😎. Thanks to its qualities, you will feel a pleasant aftertaste for a long time!👌

Portion size: 0,8g
Nicotine: 16mg/1gram
Nicotine per portion: 12,8mg
Portions in one package: 20 pc
